tools.name: submit_design_for_quote
tools.description:
Submit a building design to Gage and get back a real, buildable cold-formed steel (CFS) framing quote from the Gage fabricator network.

Use this when you have generated or been given a floor plan or 3D house model and need to know what it costs to frame in steel, who would fabricate it, and how it

tools.name: quote_my_building
tools.description:
Price a building in cold-formed steel framing from a plain description, through the Gage fabricator network: what it costs to have the frame fabricated and delivered, and which regional shop would build it.

Use this when someone has designed a house, ADU, cabin, garage, workshop or small commercial

tools.name: start_my_project
tools.description: Start a real Gage project from a quote, so the person can get their building fabricated: Gage creates their project with the regional fabricator that priced it and emails them a private link to it. From that page they review the quote, talk to the fabricator and follow the frame to delivery. Nothing

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_my_project · Private data: start_my_project · Public sink: submit_design_for_quote, start_my_project.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_my_project · Private data: start_my_project · Public sink: submit_design_for_quote, start_my_project

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
